metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Audit Map (Batch 9)

audit_results.title: Verify Adaptor withdraw() correctly handles all token types

input_validation_bypass.analysis: Adaptor.withdraw() validates amount != 0 at line 222. Token type is validated against known addresses (NATIVE_TOKEN, UNDERLYING_TOKEN, ZERC20_TOKEN). The function correctly identifies which debit function to call based on token address.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Passing an unrecognized token address triggers revert(InvalidToken()) at line 239. No bypass possible.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Follows checks-effects-interactions: _debitCombinedNativeBalance/_debitNativeBalance/_debitUnderlyingBalance/_debitZerc20Balance all update storage BEFORE the external call/transfer. Native: lines 225-229 debit then call. ERC20: lines 232-234 debit then safeTransfer. zERC20: lines 236-237 debit then safeTransfer.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: No unbounded loops. Single storage read and update per withdrawal. Gas consumption is bounded.

race_conditions.analysis: nonReentrant modifier applied at line 221. ReentrancyGuardTransient protects against reentrancy during native ETH transfer.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: Native transfer failure checked: require(success, TransferFailed()) at line 230. SafeERC20.safeTransfer for ERC20 tokens inherently reverts on failure.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: amount = 0 reverts (ZeroAmount). amount = user balance succeeds. amount > user balance reverts with Insufficient*Balance.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.type_confusion: Invalid token address reverts InvalidToken(). NATIVE_TOKEN (0xEeee...) handled specially for IS_NATIVE_UNDERLYING case.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: ReentrancyGuardTransient prevents reentry during native ETH callback.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Attempted combination: deposit native, withdraw as underlying when IS_NATIVE_UNDERLYING=true - handled by _debitCombinedNativeBalance which sources from both balances.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: Edge: withdraw native when balance is split between underlyingTokenBalances and nativeBalances. _debitCombinedNativeBalance at lines 519-530 correctly handles this by draining underlyingTokenBalances first, then nativeBalances.

guards_found.guard: Token type branching with InvalidToken fallback

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: User cannot withdraw more than their tracked balance. Maintained by require checks in _debit*Balance functions.

phase_4_classification.justification: No vulnerabilities found. Code correctly implements CEI pattern with proper reentrancy protection. Minor observation: _debitCombinedNativeBalance logic could be documented better for edge case clarity.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: High confidence due to clear CEI pattern, reentrancy protection, and explicit balance checks. Code paths are straightforward and well-guarded.

audit_results.title: Verify _removeStargateDust handles localDecimals < sharedDecimals correctly

input_validation_bypass.analysis: _removeStargateDust at lines 555-563 explicitly checks if localDecimals < sharedDecimals at line 558 and returns 0 to prevent underflow in the exponentiation at line 561.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Token with 4 decimals, Stargate sharedDecimals = 6: localDecimals (4) < sharedDecimals (6), returns 0.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Pure function with no state modifications. Only reads Stargate.sharedDecimals() and token decimals.

race_conditions.analysis: Pure view function. No state to race on.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: Returns 0 for edge cases instead of reverting, allowing callers to handle. quoteFee at lines 260-264 handles dustlessAmount=0 by returning tokenBridgeFee = amountAfterUnwrap. _bridgeUnderlyingToken at line 423 reverts with OutputTooLow(0, minAmountOut) when amount is 0.
faulty_error_handling.counterexample: N/A - Callers handle the 0 case appropriately.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: localDecimals = sharedDecimals: conversionRate = 1, amount unchanged. localDecimals = sharedDecimals - 1: returns 0. localDecimals = sharedDecimals + 1: conversionRate = 10, removes dust.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: quoteFee + _bridgeUnderlyingToken with incompatible token: quoteFee returns valid quote with full tokenBridgeFee, bridge reverts with OutputTooLow protecting user.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: amount = 0: conversionRate calculation irrelevant, returns 0. amount < conversionRate: dust removal makes amount 0.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: No arithmetic underflow in dust calculation. Maintained by early return when localDecimals < sharedDecimals.

phase_4_classification.justification: Edge case properly handled. Returns 0 for incompatible token configurations, and callers handle this appropriately. Design prevents bridging tokens that cannot be safely represented in Stargate's shared decimal format.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: Edge case explicitly handled. Caller behavior verified in both quoteFee and _bridgeUnderlyingToken.

audit_results.title: CRITICAL: Verify ZKP system maintains soundness (bn254 sub-100-bit security)

input_validation_bypass.analysis: Verifier.proveTransferRoot at line 266 decodes proof as uint256[32] and passes to IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof at line 275. Verifier.teleport and singleTeleport similarly decode proofs and call respective deciders. Proof structure is enforced by abi.decode.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Malformed proof data: abi.decode would revert. Invalid proof passing to decider: verifyOpaqueNovaProof returns false, require at line 275 reverts.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Proof verification happens BEFORE any state updates. proveTransferRoot: verification at line 275, then state updates at lines 290-293. teleport/_teleport: verification at line 326, then state update and mint at lines 377-382.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: Groth16 verification is O(1) with fixed proof size. Gas cost bounded by verifier circuit complexity.

race_conditions.analysis: nonReentrant on teleport/singleTeleport at lines 312, 342. proveTransferRoot uses whenNotPaused but no reentrancy modifier - however, no external calls before state updates.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: InvalidProof() error thrown on verification failure at lines 275, 326, 348. Emergency pause triggered on conflicting roots at lines 284-289.
faulty_error_handling.counterexample: Divergent roots: same index with different newRoot triggers _pause() and EmergencyTriggered event.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: Empty proof: abi.decode fails. Max uint256 values in proof: handled by decider verification.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.type_confusion: Groth16 proof passed to Nova decider: would fail verification. Wrong decider address: set by owner, trusted.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Proof submission timing: provedTransferRoots are indexed by newIndex, no timing exploitation possible.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Submit valid proof, then submit same proof again: second submission would have existingRoot != 0 but == newRoot, so no emergency (line 284 condition).
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: First proof (oldIndex=0): $.provedTransferRoots[0] = INITIAL_TRANSFER_ROOT set at line 238, so oldRoot check passes.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: Only cryptographically valid proofs update protocol state. Maintained by require statements on verification results. BN254 provides sub-100-bit security against ECDLP.

phase_4_classification.justification: On-chain verification logic is sound. However, ZKP soundness depends on: (1) correctness of decider implementations, (2) trusted setup integrity for Groth16, (3) Nova IVC library (sonobe) soundness. These are trusted components.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: On-chain logic verified. Underlying cryptographic soundness depends on external audited libraries (sonobe/folding-schemes, ark-groth16) and trusted setup. BN254 sub-100-bit security is a known limitation.

audit_results.title: CRITICAL: Verify double-spend prevention via monotonic totalTeleported

input_validation_bypass.analysis: _teleport at lines 377-380 enforces strict monotonicity: require(value > currentTotal, NothingToWithdraw(currentTotal, value)). Cannot bypass as it's a require statement on verified proof values.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Replay proof with same value: value == currentTotal fails the > check. Proof with lower value: value < currentTotal fails.

state_transition_violation.analysis: totalTeleported update at line 380 happens BEFORE mint at line 382. CEI pattern followed. State is updated atomically in same transaction.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: totalTeleported is uint256. Overflow impossible in practice as value is constrained by token supply and 248-bit field.

race_conditions.analysis: nonReentrant modifier on teleport/singleTeleport prevents concurrent execution. Atomic transaction semantics in EVM.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: NothingToWithdraw error correctly indicates duplicate/invalid proof. No silent failures.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: currentTotal = 0, value = 1: passes, mints 1. currentTotal = MAX_VALUE, value = MAX_VALUE: fails with NothingToWithdraw. currentTotal = 100, value = 101: passes, mints 1.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Front-running: not beneficial as proof is user-specific (recipient binding).
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Multiple proofs with increasing values: each succeeds, minting the delta. Design is correct.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: First teleport (currentTotal = 0): diff = value, full amount minted. Equal values: reverts.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: For each recipient, totalTeleported is strictly monotonically increasing. Proof values encode cumulative amounts, so replay mathematically fails monotonicity check.

phase_4_classification.justification: Double-spend prevention is robust. Monotonicity check with strict inequality ensures each proof can only be used once effectively. Cumulative value design means replays are mathematically rejected.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: Clear mathematical invariant. Strict inequality with cumulative values provides bulletproof double-spend protection.

audit_results.title: CRITICAL: Verify cross-chain message authentication via source EID

input_validation_bypass.analysis: Verifier._lzReceive at line 439: require(origin.srcEid == $.hubEid, InvalidHubSource(origin.srcEid)). Only accepts messages from configured hubEid. OAppUpgradeable base class provides peer verification via setPeer.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Message from non-hub EID: reverts with InvalidHubSource. Spoofed origin: LayerZero endpoint validates message authenticity.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Source validation at line 439 happens BEFORE payload processing at lines 441-449. State only updated after authentication passes.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: O(1) operations. Single storage update per message.

race_conditions.analysis: EVM atomicity. No reentrancy in _lzReceive. LayerZero endpoint calls are ordered.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: InvalidHubSource error provides clear failure reason. No silent message drops.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: hubEid = 0 during init: would be a configuration issue, not runtime. srcEid = hubEid: passes.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Message ordering: LayerZero provides ordered delivery. Duplicate messages handled by checking globalTransferRoots[aggSeq_] at line 442.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Send from fake hub address but same EID: impossible as EID is enforced by LayerZero DVN consensus.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: First global root (aggSeq_ = 0): $.globalTransferRoots[0] == 0, so it's stored. Duplicate: line 442 check prevents overwrite.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: Only Hub-originated messages update global roots. Maintained by EID validation and LayerZero DVN consensus (13/19 supermajority).

phase_4_classification.justification: Cross-chain authentication is properly implemented. Dual-layer security: application-layer EID check + transport-layer DVN consensus.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: EID validation explicit and correct. LayerZero security model (DVN supermajority) is trusted assumption.

audit_results.title: CRITICAL: Verify zERC20 minting restricted to authorized pathways only

input_validation_bypass.analysis: zERC20.mint at lines 188-191: require(msg.sender == minter(), OnlyMinter()). zERC20.teleport at lines 145-151: require(msg.sender == verifier(), OnlyVerifier()). Both pathways require specific authorized address.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Call mint() from non-minter: reverts OnlyMinter(). Call teleport() from non-verifier: reverts OnlyVerifier().

state_transition_violation.analysis: Authorization check happens BEFORE _mint call in both functions. No state change on failed auth.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: O(1) authorization check. Mint bounded by 248-bit value constraint.

race_conditions.analysis: No race conditions. Authorization is checked atomically. minter()/verifier() storage is only settable by owner.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: Clear custom errors: OnlyMinter(), OnlyVerifier(). No silent failures.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: msg.sender = minter address: mint succeeds. msg.sender = verifier address: teleport succeeds. msg.sender = address(0): fails (can't be sender).
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: setMinter/setVerifier require onlyOwner, which is trusted.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Call via delegatecall: msg.sender would be different. Not possible as contracts don't expose delegatecall.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: minter = address(0): no one can mint via that pathway. verifier = address(0): no one can teleport.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: Tokens can only be minted by LiquidityManager (via minter) or Verifier (via teleport). Enforced by msg.sender checks.

phase_4_classification.justification: Minting authorization is bulletproof. Two explicit pathways with strong authentication. Owner-controlled configuration.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: Direct msg.sender comparison. No proxies or complex delegation. Authorization is unambiguous.

audit_results.title: CRITICAL: Verify all zERC20 values constrained to BN254 scalar field

input_validation_bypass.analysis: zERC20._update override at lines 155-162 checks: require(value <= type(uint248).max, ValueTooLarge()). This hook is called for ALL transfers including mint and burn (OpenZeppelin ERC20 design).
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Transfer value = type(uint248).max + 1: reverts ValueTooLarge(). Mint bypassing _update: not possible, _mint calls _update.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Value check at line 156 happens BEFORE super._update at line 157. Invalid values never reach balance update.

race_conditions.analysis: No race conditions. Atomic transaction.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: ValueTooLarge() custom error provides clear failure reason.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: value = type(uint248).max (2^248-1): passes. value = type(uint248).max + 1 (2^248): reverts. value = 0: passes (allowed).
phase_2_counterexample_construction.type_confusion: uint256 value compared to uint248 max. Comparison is safe as uint248.max fits in uint256.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Multiple small mints summing to > MAX: Each individual mint is checked. Balance itself isn't checked, only transfer value. HOWEVER: individual values capped ensures total balance can't exceed MAX in practice without overflow.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: teleport() calls _mint which calls _update with check. OFT _credit also calls _mint. All paths covered.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: No single transfer can exceed 2^248-1. This ensures ZK circuit compatibility. Note: Total supply could theoretically exceed this via many small mints, but practical supply limits make this impossible.

phase_4_classification.justification: Value constraint properly enforced on all transfer operations. BN254 field compatibility maintained. The check is on individual transfer values, not balances, which is the correct approach for hash chain computation.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: Override of _update ensures universal coverage. OpenZeppelin ERC20 guarantees _update is called for all balance changes.

audit_results.title: Verify LiquidityManager calculates wrap reward using IncentiveLib

input_validation_bypass.analysis: LiquidityManager._wrap at line 274 calls $.feeParams.quoteWrapReward(liquidityBefore, feeSurplus_, received). IncentiveLib.quoteWrapReward at line 145 handles all edge cases including T=0, amount=0.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: feeParams with T=0: returns 0 reward (IncentiveLib:194-196). amount=0: already checked in _wrap at line 253.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Reward calculation at line 274 uses pre-deposit liquidity (liquidityBefore at line 273). feeSurplus updated at line 276 BEFORE mint at line 278. CEI pattern followed.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: O(1) mathematical computation. IncentiveLib uses bounded arithmetic.

race_conditions.analysis: nonReentrant modifier on wrap at line 103.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: Reward is capped by feeSurplus in IncentiveLib:152-153. No underflow possible.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: liquidity=0, T>0: max reward region. liquidity=T: zero reward. liquidity>T: zero reward.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Front-running wrap: attacker deposits first, changes liquidity, affects reward. This is expected MEV, not a bug.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Large deposit to drain feeSurplus: capped by feeSurplus, cannot exceed it.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: feeSurplus=0: reward=0. received=0: prevented by line 269 check.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: Reward never exceeds feeSurplus. Maintained by cap in IncentiveLib.

phase_4_classification.justification: Reward calculation is mathematically sound with proper capping. Uses pre-deposit liquidity for fair calculation.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: Clear mathematical model. Capping prevents protocol insolvency. Rounding uses floor (favors protocol).

audit_results.title: Verify LiquidityManager pulls underlying tokens via SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom

input_validation_bypass.analysis: LiquidityManager._wrap at line 266 uses UNDERLYING_TOKEN.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) for ERC20. For native, msg.value is validated at line 262.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: Insufficient allowance: safeTransferFrom reverts. Insufficient balance: safeTransferFrom reverts.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Token pull at line 266 happens BEFORE reward calculation and mint. Balance delta computed at line 267.

race_conditions.analysis: nonReentrant modifier. ERC20 callback (if any) would be blocked.

faulty_error_handling.analysis: SafeERC20 reverts on failure. Additionally, line 269 requires received != 0.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: amount = 0: caught at line 253. amount = user balance: succeeds if allowance sufficient. amount > user balance: safeTransferFrom reverts.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.timing_attacks: Fee-on-transfer tokens: received = balanceAfter - balanceBefore handles this. Reward calculated on received, not amount.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: Rebase token during wrap: received captures actual amount transferred.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: Native underlying: msg.value used directly at line 263, no transferFrom needed.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: Underlying tokens must be received before minting zERC20. Maintained by balance-based verification and SafeERC20.

phase_4_classification.justification: Token pull is properly implemented with SafeERC20 and balance verification. Handles both ERC20 and native ETH.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: SafeERC20 usage correct. Balance delta calculation handles edge cases.

audit_results.title: Verify LiquidityManager mints zERC20 equal to received + reward

input_validation_bypass.analysis: LiquidityManager._wrap at line 277: amountOut = received + reward. Line 278: ZERC20_TOKEN.mint(receiver, amountOut). Mint amount is exactly received + reward.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: N/A - Direct assignment.

state_transition_violation.analysis: amountOut calculated at line 277 after feeSurplus update at line 276. Mint at line 278 is the final state change.

resource_exhaustion.analysis: Single mint call. Amount bounded by received + reward (both bounded).

race_conditions.analysis: nonReentrant modifier prevents reentrancy during mint callback (if any exists in zERC20).

faulty_error_handling.analysis: zERC20.mint checks msg.sender == minter(). If LiquidityManager not set as minter, reverts OnlyMinter.

phase_2_counterexample_construction.boundary_values: received = max, reward = 0: mints max. received = 0: caught by UnderlyingPullFailed. received + reward overflow: practically impossible as both bounded by token supply.
phase_2_counterexample_construction.combination_attacks: N/A
phase_2_counterexample_construction.edge_cases: reward = 0 (no incentive): mints exactly received.

phase_3_guard_search.invariant_evaluation: Invariant: Minted amount = underlying received + liquidity incentive reward. Directly enforced by code logic.

phase_4_classification.justification: Mint calculation is straightforward and correct. No arithmetic issues.

phase_5_confidence.confidence_justification: Simple addition. Both operands verified positive. No overflow risk.

input_validation_bypass.counterexample: mint reverts: wrap reverts, no balance change. mint succeeds: balance increased atomically.

state_transition_violation.analysis: OpenZeppelin _mint is atomic. Balance update and total supply update happen in same call.

audit_results.title: Verify unwrap handles low liquidity by increasing fee (no revert)

input_validation_bypass.analysis: IncentiveLib.quoteUnwrapFee at lines 169-176: if liquidity <= amount, calculates fee as amount - liquidityMinusFee. This means higher fee when liquidity is scarce.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample: liquidity = 100, amount = 200: fee increases to consume more of the amount. User receives less but transaction succeeds.

state_transition_violation.analysis: Fee is calculated, not a revert condition. State transitions proceed normally.

race_conditions.analysis: N/A
